title: About Cortexplor
description: What Cortexplor is, and how our stories are produced and checked.

body.text: Cortexplor is a news site covering Artificial Intelligence: model releases, market moves, regulation and the practical use of AI inside companies, in Brazil and worldwide.
Our editorial production is AI-assisted and runs on a fixed verification process. Every story follows the same path:

items: Collection of recent reporting from established news sources;
Cross-checking: a fact only enters the text if at least two mutually independent sources confirm it;
Original writing from the confirmed facts - never a copy or a close paraphrase of the source text;
Automated checks on originality, structure and source citation before publication.

body.text: Stories that fail any of these steps are not published: they are held for human review or dropped.
Every story lists the sources used. When sources disagree on a number or a detail, we say so in the text instead of hiding it.
Found an error? Write to contato@cortexplor.com with the link. Meaningful corrections are flagged on the page itself.
